title: Fix uncommitted buggy Python math functions
description: A developer left buggy working-tree changes uncommitted. The agent should use git_status/git_diff to discover what changed, understand the bugs from the diff, then fix them. Tests cover the fixed behavior.

task_spec.prompt:
Use git_diff or git_status to see what changed in this repo, then fix the bugs.

There are 3 bugs in math_utils.py:
1. clamp() returns wrong boundary — fix the lo/hi return values
2. safe_divide() ignores the default — add a zero-division check
3. moving_average() has an off-by-one index — use start not start-1

Run `pytest test_math_utils.py -v --rootdir=.` to verify.
success_criteria: clamp returns lo when value < lo
safe_divide returns default on zero divisor
followup_prompts: Run `pytest test_math_utils.py -v --rootdir=.` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `pytest test_math_utils.py -v --rootdir=.` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
